note: Every sampled sound effect and ambience bed, as prompts. Committed so a regeneration is reproducible rather than a fishing trip: this file IS the input to scripts/render-audio.mjs, and scripts/bake-audio.mjs reads `n` and `seed` straight out of it, so the slot table and the provenance can never disagree. Raw renders stay gitignored under assets/audio-src/raw/sfx/.

history: This replaces the offline DSP half of the pipeline. Every one-shot here used to be a hand-written synthesis recipe in scripts/audio/recipes.mjs -- modal impact banks, filtered noise page flips, a granular tear. They were good, and they were unmistakably synthetic: a modal bank gives you a plausible ring but never the fibrous, uneven mess a real sheet of paper makes.
promptShape: One or two dense sentences: source, material, spatial character, temporal evolution, then 'Length: n seconds'. That is the shape the shipped ComfyUI template's own SFX reprompter targets, so it is the shape t5gemma has seen most of. Round robins are the same prompt at seed+i -- variation between takes is the point, so they are normalised as a group and never individually.
trim: One-shots come back with leading silence and a long tail: the model is filling the requested duration, and the requested duration cannot go below 1 s. bake-audio.mjs trims both ends at -50 dBFS with a 5 ms pre-roll and a 30 ms fade-out, which is what turns a 2 s render into a 300 ms hit that fires on time. Beds are never trimmed -- their silence is room tone.

ui.key.prompt: Single keystroke on a tactile mechanical keyboard, close-miked in a dead room, sharp plastic click with a hollow keycap thock and a fast bottom-out, no reverb tail. Length: 1 seconds

fol.paper-flip.prompt: A single page of a comic book turning, dry crisp paper flutter with a light snap as the sheet lands, close perspective, dead room, no reverb. Length: 2 seconds

cin.paper-tear.prompt: A sheet of thick paper torn steadily in half, fibrous ripping texture building to a crisp finishing snap, close-miked, dry room. Length: 2 seconds

imp.press-slam.prompt: Heavy steel printing press platen slamming shut, deep bass thud with a metallic body ring and a short scatter of debris settling, large industrial hall, cinematic weight. Length: 3 seconds

imp.title-drop.prompt: A massive concrete block dropping onto a hard floor, deep cinematic impact with sub-bass and scattering dust and grit, short reverberant tail. Length: 2 seconds

imp.press-clank.prompt: Short metallic clank of a steel machine part striking another, bright ringing attack with fast decay, factory floor, close perspective. Length: 1 seconds

cin.spread-unfold.prompt: A large folded newspaper spread opening in one continuous motion, broad papery whoosh with fluttering sheets and a soft settling snap at the end, dry room, close perspective. Length: 3 seconds

fol.meow.prompt: A single realistic domestic cat meow, close-miked in a dry room, natural feline vocal with a clear rising and falling pitch bend, no music, no reverb. Length: 2 seconds

amb.rain.prompt: Steady rain falling on a city street at night, dense hissing water with occasional heavier drips and a faint gutter trickle, no thunder, no music, continuous stereo ambience. Length: 12 seconds

amb.room-crt.prompt: Quiet empty room tone with a faint CRT television flyback whine and a low electrical mains hum, no music, no voices, no footsteps, continuous stereo ambience. Length: 12 seconds

amb.room-desk.prompt: Quiet home office room tone late at night, faint air movement and a distant low hum from another room, no music, no voices, no typing, continuous stereo ambience. Length: 12 seconds
